requiredHandoff.naiveDirectionBoundary: left[t] -> right[t] is a one-way reconstruction test, not joint stereo
requiredHandoff.predictedTarget: direct camera transforms [I_4, Q_R0, Q_L1, Q_R1] in the audited proposed path
requiredHandoff.baseReconstructionLoss: left/right target reconstruction with existing L1 + LPIPS
requiredHandoff.proposedNumericConstraint: mean valid abs(||t(T_R<-L)||_2 - B), B = 0.25 m
requiredHandoff.masking: valid stereo pair/positive baseline only; non-finite predictions are hard failures
requiredHandoff.fixedGeometry: accepted deterministic SE(3) -> c2w -> patch-ray/Plucker -> Render path is a prerequisite
requiredHandoff.gradientOwnership: B is non-trainable dataloader metadata; the proposed baseline loss must backpropagate to the existing camera prediction path; GT pose is evaluator-only
requiredHandoff.verifiedEvidence: missing raw metric-scale capability is supported for audited baselines; no accepted positive stereo+B CUPID result exists
requiredHandoff.unverifiedDesign: exact B3 attachment point, camera-head ownership, CUPID insertion point, and any learned module
